## v0.2.1 (2026-11-16)


## Verify your download

Checksums (also the `SHA256SUMS` asset):

```
8e20dfdc8ef3db2232a2bca4589a152af9ff228ba0245a20f6d78fe8965e0226  beeadhoc-0.2.1.cdx.json
62db6ef9e586100e429dd2a8a8a47406bea9b2c1a62b1fe24763cbe3212da46c  beeadhoc-0.2.1.tar.gz
```

```
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing   # in the directory you downloaded to
```

Every asset carries signed SLSA build provenance (`beeadhoc-0.2.1.intoto.jsonl`, and the Sigstore bundle `beeadhoc-0.2.1.sigstore.json`) and is described by a CycloneDX SBOM (`beeadhoc-0.2.1.cdx.json`). With the GitHub CLI, for any asset, e.g. `beeadhoc-0.2.1.tar.gz`:

```
gh attestation verify beeadhoc-0.2.1.tar.gz --repo swarm-routing/BeeAdHoc --signer-workflow swarm-routing/.github/.github/workflows/reusable-release.yml
gh attestation verify beeadhoc-0.2.1.tar.gz --repo swarm-routing/BeeAdHoc --predicate-type https://cyclonedx.org/bom --signer-workflow swarm-routing/.github/.github/workflows/reusable-release.yml
gh attestation verify beeadhoc-0.2.1.tar.gz --repo swarm-routing/BeeAdHoc --bundle beeadhoc-0.2.1.sigstore.json --signer-workflow swarm-routing/.github/.github/workflows/reusable-release.yml   # offline
```
